name: Enter the Gungeon: Deluxe Edition
storyline: A group of misfits, each burdened by deep personal regret, descends into the Gungeon, a sprawling, ever-shifting fortress inhabited by hostile creatures made of ammunition called the Gundead. Their shared goal is to reach the deepest level of this labyrinth and claim its legendary treasure: a mythical gun said to have the power to kill the past. Each Gungeoneer carries their own reasons for seeking this weapon, hoping that by undoing their greatest mistake, they might find absolution.
summary:
This version includes:

- The physical version of Enter the Gungeon with all DLC,
- Exclusive “Shotgun Kin” Playable Skin
- Exclusive Stickers
- Exclusive Bullet Kin Paper craft
- Reversible Jacket Artwork and a download code for the Original Soundtrack of Enter the Gungeon.
